title: Fridgeroo on Tour – Part 4: The gym bro's kitchen
feature: barcode scan + tags (scan a pack, the tub gets a name tag)

scenes.label: 🚨 14 TUBS. NO NAMES

caption: Part 4 of Fridgeroo on Tour: 14 identical meal-prep tubs, and one barcode scan plus tags found the chicken in seconds 💪 Use it or lose it. fridgeroo.netlify.app – Which tub would you gamble on?

newProps.tubs: 14 identical grey rounded tubs (2×7 flat grid on the counter, never stacked). Action tubs {popAt, tagAt}: lids pop open in a wave (rice, oats, beige slop, one green mystery with puff); at tagAt a red laser line sweeps the grid and white name tags (CHICKEN/RICE/OATS/???) stamp onto the fronts with a squash; tub 9 gets a gold glow.

voiceText: [shouting, heroic] Fourteen tubs. Zero names. [long pause] [deadpan, unimpressed] Bro, that's mystery protein. [long pause] [slow, serious, to camera] YOU sniff-test your dinner too. [long pause] [proud, warm] Scan it. Tag it. Chicken found.
